description: Caesar cipher with any shift 1–25, plus a brute-force cracker that shows all 25 possible shifts.

faqs.a: Each letter shifts a fixed number of places (A→D with shift 3). Decoding shifts back by the same amount.
faqs.q: How does the Caesar cipher work?

faqs.a: It tries all 25 shifts and lists every result, so you can spot the readable one.
faqs.q: How does the crack mode work?

faqs.a: No — it is a classical teaching cipher and is trivially broken by brute force.

howto: Enter text and pick a shift from 1 to 25.
Choose Encode, Decode, or Crack (shows all 25 shifts).
title: Caesar Cipher Tool
